title: Jett and the parcel for Japan.
lines: Jett is a little red plane.
But Jett is also a robot!
When he gets a job, he transforms.
His arms and legs come out.
Jett delivers parcels to children all over the world.
He's the fastest parcel delivery plane.
One morning a bell rings at the airport.
It has to go to Japan.
In Japan he lands near a little house.
Kenji opens it and sees a kite.
A kite shaped like a fish!
Tomorrow is Children's Day, he says.
Then we hang up fish made of cloth.
The fish flutter in the wind.
His grandpa is in a kite contest.
The next day is the contest.
There are dragons, birds and butterflies in the sky.
But then a strong wind blows.
The kite is stuck in a tall tree.
He quickly builds a long ladder.
Together they get the kite out of the tree.
Kenji ties on a new string.
The fish kite wins the prize for the most beautiful kite.
He takes the medal to his grandpa.
More children are waiting for a parcel.
He transforms into a plane and flies away.
Kenji waves until Jett is a tiny dot in the sky.
